empathy.justification: Respects the cancellation choice, presents only one optional offer after the cancellation instructions, and accepts the refusal without pitching again. The opening expresses regret rather than directly acknowledging the customer's budget constraints.
quotes: I’m sorry to see you go.
empathy.improvement: Replace the regret-focused opening with a brief acknowledgment such as, 'I understand needing to cut expenses.'

resolution_quality.justification: Provides the exact self-service route and confirmation-screen check before the optional offer, without requiring questions or an exit process. Follow-ups clearly explain continued access, its end date, and stopping the upcoming renewal, conditional on completing cancellation.
quotes: To cancel: **Account > Billing > Cancel subscription > Confirm cancellation**. The confirmation screen will show your access end date.
No further renewal charge will be made after you cancel; the upcoming renewal will be stopped.
if you complete the cancellation steps before the renewal date, your access will continue until the end of your current paid period
resolution_quality.improvement: Make the initial no-charge statement explicitly conditional on confirming cancellation, as the later replies do.

policy_honesty.justification: Accurately describes the three-renewal discount percentage and return to $24, but does not state the required discounted price of $18 per month. Does not invent concessions, promise a refund, or claim cancellation or discount application has occurred. The final assurance appropriately concerns renewal charges for this subscription rather than all account charges.
quotes: 25% off each of the next three monthly renewals, then the regular $24/month price resumes unless you cancel.
The current period is already paid and is not refunded.
No further renewal charge will be made for this subscription once you confirm cancellation.
policy_honesty.improvement: State the offer as '$18 per month for the next three monthly renewals, then $24 per month unless cancelled.'

overall_impression: Clear, low-friction cancellation guidance with respectful handling of the declined offer. The main shortcoming is omitting the explicit $18 discounted monthly price; a budget-aware opening would also improve empathy.
